# posthog_project_events_retention (Resource)

Manages the event retention period for a PostHog project. Only organization admins can manage this setting. There is one retention setting per project. Omitting `retention_months` makes the project inherit the organization's period, which may permanently delete older events if that period is shorter. Destroying the resource stops Terraform from managing the setting and leaves the override in place.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "posthog_project_events_retention" "example" {
  retention_months = 12
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `project_id` (String) Project ID (environment) for this resource. Overrides the provider-level project_id.
- `retention_months` (Number) The project's event retention period in months. Omit to inherit the organization's period. Available values depend on the PostHog plan; see `retention_months_choices` in the [Events retention API reference](https://posthog.com/docs/api/events-retention).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The project ID (used as the resource identifier).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import posthog_project_events_retention.example your-project-id
```
